newsitem.title: CANADA: CBRS puts Avenor, Repap under review.
newsitem.headline: CBRS puts Avenor, Repap under review.

text.p: Canadian Bond Rating Service said on Thursday that it put Avenor Inc and Repap Enterprises Inc credit ratings under review.
CBRS said it will closely monitor the development of the proposed transaction announced Wednesday in which Avenor made an all stock bid to acquire Repap.
The transaction includes the issuance of 29 million new shares of Avenor, and is valued at a total of C$3.3 billion, including the assumption of Repap debt.
CBRS rates Avenor debentures and senior notes at B+(High) with a positive outlook, and its convertible debentures at B(High) with a positive outlook.

CBRS rates Repap's convertible debentures at B(Low) with stable outlook and Repap New Brunswick Inc's first priority senior secured notes at B(High) with stable outlook and its second priority senior secured notes at B, with stable outlook.
